summary: World of Goo entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: World of Goo
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release, with build/update and input state documented

emulation.notes: Use native PC route; Dolphin only for Wii-control comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build, with Wii hardware for pointer-control comparison

primary.why: World of Goo's PC release is the best capture/settings route for the physics puzzler, while Wii and mobile versions preserve distinct pointer/touch control contexts. The 2019 update and later storefront builds should be logged because they affect display and compatibility.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release through Steam/GOG or 2D Boy/Tomorrow Corporation route. Record storefront/build, resolution, input device, profile/completion state, OCD flags, online World of Goo Corporation state, and whether Wii/mobile controls were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting alternate input feel.
secondary.why: PC is cleaner for capture, but Wii/touch controls change interaction.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record build/update, input device, OCD/completion state, and online feature availability.
